scores.rationale: The candidate implementation was halted midway through development, leaving two of its four facets unchecked in `.lore/dod.md` (which was also left committed in the working tree). Functionally, `ToolRegistry` compiles schemas only once at `register` time for all tools, failing the requirement that function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` definitions resolve and validate against their current schema per `execute` call (cached via `WeakMap`). Furthermore, it uses default `import Ajv from 'ajv'` (which can break under `NodeNext`/ESM typechecking compared to named `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`), omits the required one-line JSDoc on `execute`, and logs `inputKeys` rather than failing `paths` on validation failure. Most required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, and none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` were made.
